balls.text: Short and wide of off, pulls it away to deep midwicket for one.
Short and wide
ANother full toss outside off, connects it well this time to dispatch it over long-off for a 89m six!
Full toss outside off, looks to reverse sweep and misses
Hundred for Brook! He has done it. Length ball around off, flat-bats it toward long-on
Low full toss around off, chips it to the left of deep midwicket
Short of deep midwicket! Length ball, pace off,  on middle, hits it towards vacant midwicket region
Low full toss on leg stump, moves away and guides it in front of square for another four!
Short ball on leg, he swings his bat hard at it, an outside edge, and the ball flies over the keeper for four
Fuller down the leg, Brook moves across and drills it to deep cover
Fuller down the leg, Brook moves across and hits it along the ground towards point for four
Full on middle, goes back and guides it to wide of long-on for one
Length ball around off, Abhishek looks to go big but doesn't get the distant, Thakur runs in from long-on and completes the catch just outside the ring
Full outside off, an outswinger, swing and a miss for Abhishek. wide
Into the 90s! Short ball outside off, goes back and pulls it away to deep square leg for four. 200 for SRH
Length ball around off, smashes it over midwicket for another hugeee six! 91m
Full on middle, goes back and punches it to vacant midwicket region for a quick single
Length ball outside off, drills it to legside for one
Short ball outside off, just taps it to wide of the bowler for one
In the slot, on middle, goes down on one knee, and whacks a 96m six over midwicket!
Fuller around off, guides it to long-on
Punches it to long-on for one
Fuller outside off, hits straight to cover fielder
Short of length outside off, cut away towards point for four
Length ball around off, kept low, drills it to deep mdiwicket
Full outside off, comes down and digs it between deep cover and long-off for a four
Fuller outside off, chips it toward deep point for four. Thakur puts in a dive but can't stop it
Short of length around off, drills it to wide long-on for one
Uff! Length ball around off, goes back and whacks it straight  over umpire's head for four
Full outside off, comes down and hits it towards long-off
Fuller wide of off, drills it to deep cover for two
Short ball and punished towards point! Uses the creases well and moves across to hit it toward offside for four
143.4kmph.Full on leg, Brook moves across and misses
Fuller outside off, Brook moves across quickly and helps is between the keeper and short third
Slow full toss outside off, opens the face of the bat and guides it to deep point
Wide yorker, picks this up nicely and hits it over mid-off for four
Fuller wide of off, Brook moves across to help it over the keeper but misses. Looks like he got a bit of bat to it. Umpire raises his finger but Brook reviews it. UltraEdge confirms no bat involved.
Slower ball. Full outside off, smashes it over long-off for a  92m six!
Length ball on middle, goes back and taps it to legside for a quick single
Length ball around off, slaps it to deep cover
Full outside off, pushes  it to covers
Dropped! Fuller around off, Abhishek swings his bat at it but can't connect, Shardul runs in a few yards from deep cover but couldn't hold on to it
Fuller on middle and off, guides to backward point
Length ball around off, pushed to dee point to get off the mark
Fuller around off, goes on one knee to clear the deep midwicket boundary only to be caught by Russell near the boundary line. 72-run stand has been broken!
Length ball on middle, clears his front leg and launches it over long-on. Fifty for Markram
Misfiled at long-off! Length outside off, comes down the track and hits a four
Full outsider off, guides it to deep midwicket on the back foot
99kmph. Length ball on middle, goes back and drills it to deep midwicket for two
Short of length outside off, goes back and punches it toward point. 16 off the over
Fuller on middle, brings out a reverse sweep to go over point for four
95.3kmp. Fuller on middle stump, defended back to bowler
Googly, short of a length outside off, goes back and launches it over midwicket for  a big six
Fuller outside off, goes for a cut and misses
Fuller outside off, hits a flat six over covers
length ball on the stumps. Flicked to the right of long-on but only one this time
length ball around off. Goes back and works it to the right of deep midwicket where Russell fumbles, allowing an easy second
full on the pads, glanced towards short fine leg. Was looking for a single but sent back by Brook
Fifty for Brook, off 32 balls. A length ball around off. Goes back and works it towards deep midwicket
length ball around off. Comes forward and pushes it towards long-on for one more
full around off. Driven towards long-on
Markram finished the over with a six. Full and just outside off. Markram clears his front leg and launches it over long-off for an 81-metre six
another googly. Full but way outside off. Markram fails to connect the cut
short of length outside off. Goes for the cut but ends up chopping it behind the stumps
worked towards deep midwicket, and they are coming back for the second. Good running between the wicket
dropped. Another googly but short and outside off. Brook goes back and smash it straight towards the bowler. Suyash had little time to react and fails to hold on to it
starts with a googly. Full outside off. Brook looks to hit it through covers and gets an inside edge into the ground
length ball around off, punched towards long-on
full, Markram looks to go big but ends up dragging it towards deep square leg
length but down the leg side. Left alone
full around off. Punched towards long-on
full outside off. Drives it towards extra cover
length ball on the pads. Brook looks to punch, gets a bottom edge that brushes the pads and rolls towards leg side
length ball around off. Punched towards long-on
too full around off. Digs it out towards sweeper cover
full around off once again. Flicked towards long-on. Nice wrist work from Brook there
a googly. Full around off. Brook defends it on the front foot
length ball outside off. Punched towards sweeper cover off the back foot
short of length at the stumps. Goes back and pulls it towards deep square leg
length ball around off. Goes back and works it towards long-on
short of length outside off. Goes airborne and punches it towards deep point
short and Markram pulls it over deep square leg. He isn't going to miss out on those, 70 metres. There were two fielders in the deep on the leg side
a slower one, full toss down the leg side. Helped towards deep-backward square leg
short of length at the stumps, bowled wide of the crease. Markram pulls it towards deep square leg where Ferguson does well to make the stop
full around off. Markram comes forward and punches it back towards the bowler
length ball around off. Drops it towards next to the stumps for a single
full around off. Driven towards mid-off
tucked away towards square leg
short of length outside off, spinning away. Brook rocks back and cuts it to the right of the point fielder who puts in a dive but cannot stop the ball. Should have been stopped
length ball at the stumps. Brook looks to flick but misses and is hit on the inside of the front pad
a huge appeal for caught-behind but the umpire calls it a wide. Was short of length, fired down the leg side. Brook went for the pull but couldn't connect
length ball outside off. Pushed towards backward point for one. Off the mark
starts with a googly. Short of length at the stumps. Pulled towards deep midwicket

Russell has two in the over, he started celebrating even before Gurbaz completed the catch. Was a bouncer at 136.9kph. Just outside off. Tripathi went for the pull only to top-edge it straight up. Gurbaz finished the catch to his left, still behind the stumps
a low full toss on the toes, and Tripathi clips it in front of square leg. Suyash Sharma had no chance of chasing it down
length ball at the stumps. Tucked away towards deep square leg
a slower one but way down the leg side. Brook looks to help it on its way but it's too far away from him
short of length outside off. Gets on the top of the bounce and cuts it down towards sweeper cover
and he gets off the mark with a boundary. Short, at the body, but Tripathi is up to it. Pulls it to the left of long leg for four
and he picks up a wicket first ball. Was short of length around off. Agarwal was on the move, and was cramped. He looked to steer it away only to get an outside edge to Varun at short third
length ball on the stumps. Punched towards long-on off the back foot. Just three singles from that over
length ball at the stumps, punched towards long-on
short of length at the stumps. Drags a pull towards long-on
three dots. Length ball on the stumps. Agarwal looks to play that half-sweep, half-pull but is late on the shot and gets hit on the leg
length ball outside off, pushed back towards the bowler
a length ball around off and spinning in. Agarwal flicks it towards short fine leg. He wanted a single but Brook sends him back
Six more. And this is an even better shot. It was bowled at 142kph but Brook had so much time that he went on the back foot and cut it over point. Moves to 31 off just 11
139.5kph. Brook is showing his class now. Moves towards the leg side, gets a full toss outside and just slices it over the cover boundary, 71 metres
length ball on the stumps. Pushed towards mid-on for a quick single
Brook shows his stumps but Umesh has bowled this almost yorker-length outside off. Brook can only jam his bat at it. A single as the ball rolls towards square leg
an outside edge but there's no slip. Varun at short third is very fine and it goes to him on the bounce. He makes a partial stop, allowing the batters a single
length ball around off. Agarwal comes out of his crease and punches it to the left of the cover fielder, where Russell makes a tumbling stop
smashed again but this time straight to the cover fielder
a slower one, 124kph, but ends up as a low full toss. Brook exposes his stumps and crashes it to the cover boundary

five wides. Short and angling towards the batter. Brook was backing away and looking to ramp it up. The ball, though, keeps coming in, and is also too high to connect. Flies to the left and over the keeper's head
short of length around off and middle. Agarwal hops and tucks it towards square leg for a single
length ball in the channel, left alone
short of length at the batter, tucked away towards square leg

starts with a length ball around off and middle. Agarwal moves across and flicks it through the vacant midwicket region. Varun from mid-on puts in the chase and even though he is a fair distance away from the boundary line when he intercepts the ball, he flicks it back. By the time, he gets up and throws it, the batters have jogged three
a bouncer to end the over with. Brook ducks under it
back-to-back fours for Brook. Length ball at the stumps. Brook moves towards the off side and helps it between the keeper and short fine leg
Four more to Brook. Short of length outside off, and Brook pulls this one through midwicket. Didn't get it from the middle of the bat but still enough on it for a boundary
short of length at the stumps. Tucked away towards short midwicket
extra bounce off a good length around off and middle. Came back in with the angle to hit Brook on the thigh. There was an inside edge, so that's a single to Brook
Off the mark with a boundary. Full and wide and Brook throws his bat at it. Was in the air but in the gap between cover and extra cover
Short ball outside off, doesn't connect it well while trying to go for a pull.  Sunrisers win by 23 runs!
Short ball outside off, goes for a pull and top-edges it over fine leg for a six
Short of a length ball outside off, pulled away to deep midwicket. Doesn't take the single
Looks to go over to a length ball on middle and leg, but misses. A dot ball
Short ball outside off, taps it to point and takes a single
Gone! In the slot outside off, swings his bat, gets a top edge and Washington completes an easy catch at backward point.
Dropped by Philips! Short ball on off, muscled away to deep midwicket where the fielder drops a simple catch. Pressure, pressure. 50 for Rinku
Yorker on middle and off, smashed in the gap between long-on and deep cover for four
Short ball on middle, pulled away to backward point. Shardul wanted a run, Rinku said no
Yorker on off, guides it to deep cover for two runs. Risky running
Wide yorker on off, hit towards deep backward point for four
Chips it toward deep cover for a quick two.

Dropped! Full ball outside off, Shardul looks to go big but doesn't get much distance. MArkaram runs in a few yards 
 from mid-on and puts in a dive but couldn't get hold of it
Yorker on legstump, drills it to square leg for a quick run
Short ball on off, pulled away toward legside, doesn't connect it well
Fuller on fourth stump, goes for a drive and misses
Length ball around off, swings his bat hard at it, gets a leading edge over Natarajan at short third
Full toss on leg, flicks it to deep midwicket for a run
Yorker wide of off, called wide
Full toss on leg, just directs it to deep fine leg for four
Full toss outside off, hits it toward deep cover for one
Yorker on stumps, flicks it towards deep square leg for one
Another full toss but this time it is straight to Washington at deep cover!  Rana tries to clear the offside boundary and doesn't get the distance. What an innings this has been from the KKR captain!
Shot! Full toss outside off, punished over long-on for a six. 82m!
Fuller around off, looks to scoop it over keeper and misses
Fuller on fourth stump, moves away and dispatches it over extra cover for a six! Are we going to witness anither Rinku masterclass again?
A high full toss and Rinku pulls it over deep square leg for as six. Jansen has overstepped, so that's a no-ball
Fuller down the leg, Rana moves across and digs it to backward point
Short ball, back away and goes for a pull, Washington drops an easy catch at deep square leg
Fuller on wide of leg but Rana moves across and hits it to long-on
Slow yorker on leg stump, goes for a sweep and misses. Reviewed for a wide. No bat involved, decision upheld. Stays a wide
Full toss wide of leg stump, wide
Low full toss on leg, Rinku moves across and sends it to legside as he comes down the track
Full on middle and off, hit along the ground to long-off for one
Full around off, guides it to deep midwicket for one
Low wide full toss, Rinku steers it toward short third. A single after a bit of hesitation
Low full toss on stumps, flicked to right of fine leg. Mayank puts in a slide but can't stop the boundary

Yorker on middle and leg, looks like there is a tiny bit of bat involved as the keeper collect the ball. Umpire says it's out. Rinku reviews it. UltraEdge confirms that it touched the bottom of the bat and hit the ground. Decision reversed
Full outside off, pushed to point
Fuller on leg, he moves across and sends it to deep backward leg for four
Fuller on off, hit along the ground to wide long-off
Too short and sails over batter's head, called wide
Fuller on off, smashes it over long-on for a six. Is he getting started here?
Yorker on middle, drills it to point fielder. Good comeback from Natarajan after going for 12 in his previous over
Full around off, digs it out towards long-on
Short ball on middle and off, pulled away to square leg for one
Full around off, goes back and looks for a cut but misses
Another reverse sweep to a full ball on middle but straight to short fine leg
Drills it to long-on for onw
Full on off and middle, tries to go for reverse sweep and misses. Markande appeals but umpire says no
Whacked over long-on! Fuller around off, he picks it up well to launch it over legside for a huge six
Length ball on middle and off, reverse swept away over keeper for two.
Fuller on middle, swept away to deep square leg for one
Goes back and hits it along the ground toward deep cover
Fuller on middle, gets on one knee and pulls it away to deep midwicket
Fifty for Rana! Full around off, bends down and pushes it to deep cover for two
Fuller on off, hits it straight for a 90m six!
Fuller on stumps, directs it to short fine leg
length ball outside off. Rinku goes back and flicks it towards midwicket
length around off. Drops it towards point for a quick single
and again. Another googly around off to beat Rana on the front foot
a googly. Pitching around off and leaving the batter to beat the outside edge. Rana was looking to defend it on the front foot
full around off. Driven towards long-off for one

Russell departs. A slider on the stumps. Russell backs away, clears his front leg, and aims for the moon. He gets a lot of height on it but not much distance. Jansen comes in from long-on and settles under it
bang. A length ball at the stumps. Rana clears his front leg and hits over long-on
another bouncer but it's too high. Called a wide as Rana ducks under this one as well
a bouncer to end the over with. Over the batter's shoulder who ducks under it
nails the yorker. Russell jams his bat at it, gets an inside edge onto his foot and the ball rolls on the off side
full, angling towards the pads. Rana misses the flick and gets hit on the leg. Gets a leg-bye. And Jansen has overstepped
short of length at the batter, pulled towards deep square leg
a slower length ball around off. Turned towards deep square leg
length ball around off, pushed towards covers
length ball on the stumps. Defended from the back foot
tossed up around off. Russell pushes at it gently and looks for a quick single as the ball rolls towards backward point. Sent back by Rana
length ball on the stumps. Flicked towards deep midwicket
a google on the stumps. Russell goes back and flicks it towards deep-backward square leg
taken at deep midwicket. Glenn Phillips, the substitute, with the catch. Was full on the stumps. Jagadeesan went for the slog sweep, connected it alright but ended up hitting straight to the fielder
down the track but Markande shortens his length. Punched back towards the bowler
too short and too wide but Jagadeesan misses out. Only a single to sweeper cover
length outside off. Looks to steer it finer this time. Gets beaten
length outside off. Rocks back and cuts it through point. The sweeper cover puts in the chase and the slide but cannot stop the boundary
length ball at the stumps. Flatter at 98kph. Worked towards midwicket
length ball around off, pushed towards extra cover
length ball on the stumps. Pushed towards midwicket for a couple
length ball around off, pushed towards extra cover
four more. Length outside off. More of an outside edge but beats a diving short third
dropped. Tossed up around off. Jagadeesan goes for a casual sweep, top-edging it towards deep midwicket. Tripathi was late to spot it, puts in the sprints but ends up spilling it
full around off. Swept behind square leg for one. The crowd has found its voice back
length ball on the pads. Tucked away towards deep midwicket. Jagadeesan wanted second but Rana says no
length outside off. Not a bad ball but Jagadeesan goes back and plays it late, piercing the gap between backward point and short third
make that 28 off the over. Short of length, angling towards the batter at 149.1kph. Rana backs away and cuts it over backward point. Once again hitting the boundary skirting on the full
142kph. Another short ball, another pull. A top edge this time that goes over short fine and dribbles over the boundary line - 22 off the over with one ball to go
four more! Short outside off, Rana gives himself room and hits it over extra cover. One-bounce four
short of length around off, and Rana goes after this as well. Drags the pull to the left of midwicket this time
143.6kph. Another short ball and this time Rana nails the shot this time. Pulls it over midwicket, the ball hitting the boundary cushion on the full
a top edge but goes over short fine. Was a bouncer from Malik, and Rana took it on with the pull. Lucky runs
a straight six. A length ball around off and Jagadeesan launches it over the  bowler's head to make it 12 runs off the over
a bouncer, angling across the batter. Jagadeesan sways away from it
full outside off. Looks to drive it on the up, gets a thick outside edge towards deep third
full around off. Driven firmly but finds mid-on
length ball on the stumps. Dragged towards deep square leg
short of length around off. Jagadeesan stands tall and pulls it through midwicket
length ball around off. Opens the face of the bat to work it towards deep cover
length ball on the stumps. Tucked away towards short midwicket
full outside off. Rana is a bit tentative - feet not moving much - as he pushes at it. And gets beaten

and he departs first ball. A length ball at the stumps, giving Narine no room to free arms. He still goes for the big hit but can only hit it in the air towards mid-on. Markram was again completes the dismissal
a soft dismissal. Length ball on the pads. Iyer looked to hit it over the leg side but ended up getting a leading edge towards long-on. Markram came in a few steps and pouched it
length ball around off, coming in. Iyer goes over the bowler's head and picks up a boundary
length ball at the stumps, cramping the batter who can only punch it towards mid-on
down the track but isn't to the pitch of the ball. Looks to hit it over the bowler's head and misses
over mid-off. Didn't time it well but had enough on it to clear the fielder and pick up a boundary
dropped. Length ball around off, and Jagadeesan flat-bats it back towards the bowler. He didn't middle it; despite that Bhuvneshwar had little time to react
down the track but Bhuvi has shortened his length. Jagadeesan places it towards midwicket and comes back for the second
full outside off. Jagadeesan throws his bat at it, and just manages to evade a diving Tripathi's outstretched right hand at backward point
length ball outside off and moving away. Iyer looks to hit it through the line and misses
length but angling down the leg side
length ball around off. Goes for the pull but ends up dragging it towards midwicket
length ball outside off. Steered towards point where Tripathi is quick to the ball
length ball on the pads, flicked towards deep square leg to get off the mark
length ball on the stumps. No room. Pushed towards mid-on
length ball around off. Stands tall and hits it towards cover
down the track; this one swings in to the batter. Pushed towards mid-on
length ball on the pads. Goes for the flick but misses and gets hit on the pads. A leg-bye
length ball leaving the batter. Pushed towards point
taken at deep third. Full outside off, and Gurbaz looks to go over extra cover. But he fails to middle it and ends up slicing towards deep third where Umran Malik takes a straightforward catch
length ball outside off, and swinging away. Left alone
length ball around off. Defended back
